name: House Spirit Mob

items.name: Shy
items.text: A house sprit mob is naturally Invisible while within sight of their bound area. The house spirit mob can become visible or even selectively visible—allowing only certain people to see them.

items.name: Uncooperative Surroundings
items.text: 30 feet. The house spirit mob rallies household items to hamper their foes. Each enemy in the aura that fails an attack roll, Reflex saving throw, or Acrobatics or Athletics skill check becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 round (Clumsy 2 and knocked Prone on a critical failure).

items.name: Swarming Blows
items.text: Each enemy in the mob's space takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Tragic Accident
items.text: Combining powers, the mob creates a horrific accident, dealing 5d10 untyped damage in a 10-foot burst or 20-foot line within their bound area (DC 24 basic Reflex save save). The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute, and the damage is most often bludgeoning. The mob can't use Tragic Accident again for 1d4 rounds.

text:
Even the smallest house spirits can band together against a threat to the home.

---
House spirits are a collection of fey who live among peasants and poor rural folk. They hide themselves from mortal eyes—hence why they're so commonly called "spirits"—but their presence is always felt. Given suitable respect, these house fey take a decidedly parental interest in the mortals they live with, doing all manner of work around the household. They cook, they clean, they sweep, they chop wood, they care for animals, they tend the stove. If disrespected, however, they becomes a veritable plague of ill will.
